svg.aria-label: One automated press on the test bench: the Ender moves the indenter to a bin, the sphere presses the elastomer, the load cell reads force, the markers move, the Z displacement is recorded, then the indenter retracts

g.text: Mean of 30 presses at the grid center. Δz is the mean of the 4 markers nearest the indenter. Force and Δz are as recorded.
Marker motion is drawn at true scale, not magnified. Side views are schematic and not to scale. Steps play in sequence.
